t: Section 30308(a) of title 49, United States Code, is amended by striking “and $2,550,000 for fiscal year 1995” and inserting “and $2,550,000 for each of fiscal years 1995 and 1996”.

fable.w: This section only amends an authorization-of-appropriations provision by extending a dollar amount to an additional fiscal year. There is no tempting participation reading: it involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
